_note: What Gugu says when the pairing page tries a voice ("试听"): one short line per interaction language, spoken with the chosen voice and played on the device.
zh: 你好呀！我是咕咕，一只会送信的小鸽子。你今天开心吗？
yue: 你好呀！我係咕咕，一隻識送信嘅鴿仔。你今日開唔開心呀？
en: Hi there! I'm Gugu, a little pigeon who delivers letters. Are you having a happy day?
